hook.convey: a 4-digit number met in daily life (stadium crowd, game score) → it has 4 places: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones → reading and writing it = one digit per place

use.hi: Cricket match dekhne stadium mein 7465 log aaye, aur scoreboard par yahi number chamak raha hai. Aaj seekhenge ki aise 4 ank wale number ko kaise padhte aur likhte hain.
use.en: 7465 people came to the stadium to watch a cricket match, and the scoreboard shows that number. Today we learn how to read and write such a 4-digit number.

use.hi: Video game mein tumhara score 2938 hai. Dost ko score batana ho toh ise sahi padhna aana chahiye, aur sahi likhna bhi.
use.en: Your video game score is 2938. To tell a friend your score you must read it correctly, and write it correctly too.

explain.convey: 4 places hazaar | sau | dahaai | ekai, one digit each; 7465 → 7 thousands, 4 hundreds, 6 tens, 5 ones → read place by place from the left

mustSay.en: each digit has its own place

point.hi: Dekho, 7465 mein 4 ank hain, aur har ank ki apni jagah hai: hazaar, sau, dahaai, ekai. Hazaar ki jagah 7, sau ki jagah 4, dahaai ki jagah 6, aur ekai ki jagah 5. Isliye ise padhte hain saat hazaar chaar sau painsath.
point.en: Look, 7465 has 4 digits, and each digit has its own place: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones. 7 in the thousands place, 4 in the hundreds place, 6 in the tens place, and 5 in the ones place. So we read it as seven thousand four hundred sixty-five.

prompt.hi: Isi chart mein hazaar ki jagah 5, sau ki jagah 1, dahaai ki jagah 4 aur ekai ki jagah 6 ho, toh number kya banega?
prompt.en: In this same chart, if the thousands place has 5, the hundreds place 1, the tens place 4 and the ones place 6, what number is it?

why.en: 5 thousands, 1 hundred, 4 tens and 6 ones make 5146

explain.convey: number name → numeral: each spoken part fills its own place, never the parts written side by side; two thousand three hundred forty-five → 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 → 2345, 4 digits

mustSay.en: each part to its own place

point.hi: Shabdon mein two thousand three hundred forty-five sunkar 2000 ke aage 300 aur 45 nahi chipkaate. Two thousand se hazaar ki jagah 2, three hundred se sau ki jagah 3, aur forty-five se dahaai 4, ekai 5. Number bana 2345, sirf 4 ank.
point.en: Hearing two thousand three hundred forty-five, we do not stick 300 and 45 after 2000. Two thousand gives 2 in the thousands place, three hundred gives 3 in the hundreds place, and forty-five gives 4 tens, 5 ones. The number is 2345, only 4 digits.

explain.convey: a -teen word = 1 ten and some ones (sixteen = 16); a -ty word = many tens, 0 ones (sixty = 60); the last two places of a 4-digit number come from that word

point.hi: Sixteen mein 1 dahaai aur 6 ekai hain, yaani 16. Sixty mein 6 dahaai aur 0 ekai hain, yaani 60. Sixteen, seventeen jaise shabdon mein sirf 1 dahaai hoti hai, aur sixty, seventy jaise shabdon mein kai dahaai.
point.en: Sixteen has 1 ten and 6 ones, that is 16. Sixty has 6 tens and 0 ones, that is 60. Words like sixteen and seventeen have just 1 ten, and words like sixty and seventy have many tens.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab hum 4 ank wala number padh aur likh sakte hain. Agle hisse mein dekhenge ki har ank ki value kitni hai, kyunki ek hi ank alag jagah par alag value rakhta hai.
bridgeToNext.en: Now we can read and write a 4-digit number. Next we see what each digit is worth, because the same digit in a different place has a different value.

hook.convey: a digit's worth comes from its place: the 4 in a crowd of 4625 means 4 thousand people, not 4 people; place → value

use.hi: Cricket match dekhne 4625 log aaye. Isme 4 ka matlab sirf 4 log nahi, poore 4 hazaar log hai. Aaj dekhenge ki ank ki value uski jagah se kaise badalti hai.
use.en: 4625 people came to watch a cricket match. Here the 4 does not mean just 4 people, it means a full 4 thousand people. Today we see how a digit's value changes with its place.

use.en: A train ticket has the number 8264 printed on it. The 8 here is not just eight, it is eight thousand, because it sits in the thousands place.

explain.convey: 4625: each digit × the worth of its place → 4000, 600, 20, 5; the same chart gives every digit its value

point.en: In 4625 the 4 is in the thousands place, so it is worth 4000. The 6 is in the hundreds place, worth 600. The 2 is in the tens place, worth 20, and the 5 is in the ones place, worth 5.

point.hi: Chaar hazaar pachaas mein hazaar ki jagah 4, sau ki jagah khaali, dahaai 5, ekai 0. Khaali sau ki jagah par 0 likhte hain, toh number 4050 hai. Zero hata do toh 450 bachta hai, jo sirf chaar sau pachaas hai.
point.en: In four thousand fifty the thousands place has 4, the hundreds place is empty, tens 5, ones 0. We write 0 in the empty hundreds place, so the number is 4050. Drop that zero and 450 is left, which is just four hundred fifty.
